punchline: Two Harvard professors staged a kidnapping to test an FBI negotiator, and one calm question made them give up.
thirty_sec: Chris Voss gets invited to Harvard, and Robert Mnookin springs a role play: we have your son, a million dollars or he dies. Voss smiles and asks, "How am I supposed to do that?" Then, how does he know his son is alive? Every threat gets a question. Gabriella Blum takes over and gets the same treatment. Mnookin ends up admitting the FBI might have something to teach them.
